settings.e195_C_source: experiments/eapig_overlap/results/predictions.json settings.e195_C: E214's x2 columns, checked by eapig_overlap/items.py Items.w against E214's config
settings.recipe_source: E139 amendment 2 (experiments/reuse_variable_finetune/amend2.py Config and train; results/predictions_amend2.json recipe): 3000 steps, peak 1e-5 (LLaMA-Factory's documented full-SFT peak, commute.qwen_sft.lr_at), warm-up 300 (ratio 0.1) then cosine to 0, Adam betas 0.9/0.999, no weight decay, clip 1, loss KL(F || fine-tune) at the read positions, batches drawn with replacement by a per-item seeded generator. One departure: the 24 decomposed matrices are trained and the embedding, unembedding and norms stay frozen, as decisions.md's 'Post-training' row (2026-10-14) and E147's fine-tunes (the trained items E277 and E290 read), so every change lies where both featurizations have variables; E139 trained every parameter
settings.batch_source: positions per step as E139: E139 drew 1024 windows read at one position each, sourced there as 'arm A's 32 windows of 41 tokens read ~1,300 positions' (reuse_variable_finetune/run.py Config.batch). new_few is read at its last position, so 1024 windows (E139's number); x2 is read at every one of 41 positions, so 32 windows (arm A's, finetune.ArmAConfig), 1312 positions
settings.micro_source: memory only: the gradient of a batch is accumulated over micro-batches of 256 windows (F's and the fine-tune's logits at all 41 positions, 2.1 GB each at fp32), so the step is the whole batch's; E139's windows were 8 tokens, ours 41
settings.fit_source: new_few's training windows: E214's cue builder (kstar_levels World.cues, known_edits.cues) with its own seed, so A, A' and y are the edit's, at 12,500 windows per cue: 100,000 in all, E139's fit half (variable_read.Sizes.D // 2); a window equal to one of D's 512 is dropped. x2's: E195's 301 copy24 training windows (open_pair amend1 windows_copy_trained.pt 'train'), all there are; D is its 75 held-out windows
settings.kl_m_band_source: E139 amendment 2's measured KL(M || fine-tune) on its check windows at step 2 (1.001e-7 to 1.071e-7 over seeds 0-2) and step 3 (8.94e-7 to 9.55e-7), results/amend2_always_on_s*.json train.early; step 1 runs at rate 0 (lr_at), so 2 and 3 are the first two moving steps. The band is that range divided and multiplied by 10, E229's filed factor on a measured floor: the data and read positions differ from E139's, and the guard is for an update orders of magnitude off (E40), not a percent
settings.fall_source: E139 amendment 2 at step 300: KL(F || fine-tune) 0.0090 against KL(F || M) 0.1389 on its check windows, a ratio of 0.065 (amend2_always_on_s0.json train.early step 300, train.kl_F_M); 0.5 is about 8x that, a guard that the loss falls by the end of the warm-up, not a target
settings.floor_gap_source: E139's filed floor (reuse_variable_finetune/results/predictions_amend2.json thresholds.floor_gap, from predictions.json unchanged): a gap TV(fine-tune, M) under it is no reading
settings.leftover_max_source: E139 amendment 2's measured leftover share TV(fine-tune, F) / TV(fine-tune, M) on the read half at step 3000, the end of the recipe filed above: 0.19216, 0.19185, 0.19243 for seeds 0-2 (results/amend2_always_on_s*.json steps.3000.dist tv_to_F / gap; logged by amend2.py line 151, measured by run.py distances, line 239), rounded up from the largest
settings.random_seed_source: a fixed seed named for the cell (P1.4, run 2), since the E-number is not claimed before filing; item k of the item list uses random_seed + k
settings.prior_neurons_source: E277's E_b over K at neurons (experiments/needed_neurons/results/summary.json items.<item>.E_b_K)
settings.prior_vpd_source: E268's E_b over K at VPD (experiments/kstar_needed/results/items/<item>.json E_b_K)
settings.repeat_tol_neurons_source: 10 x the larger of E277's two measured re-read differences of E_b over K at neurons, a cluster job against a pod (2.026e-6 abs on panel/lower/random_lower_s0_step128, 3.4e-7 on lower_s0_step128; experiments/needed_neurons/results/e277_makeup/compare.json items.*.E_b_K.abs_diff); 10 is E229's filed factor on a measured floor
settings.repeat_tol_vpd_source: E268's filed kept_floor: E257's measured bf16 against fp32 floor on E_b at x2 at VPD (experiments/kstar_needed/results/predictions.json settings.kept_floor); E268 read x2 and new_few from E247's saved arrays (write pass batch 8), this run reads them with a fresh fp32 write pass (batch 32), so the repeat is bounded by a measured precision floor at that site
settings.rival_gap_source: E290's filed rival gap on the same reading (experiments/ia3_control/results/predictions.json settings.rival_gap), 18x the seed sd 0.011 of this reading on E277's trained fine-tunes (needed_neurons/results/summary.json, repeat_real s0 0.0199, s1 0.0351); the measured trained readings span 0.014 to 0.038 (E277) and the built pair reads 0.995 apart (E277 x2 minus new_few)
settings.random_max_source: E278's and E290's filed random_max; measured randoms at neurons read E_b over K 0.0004 to 0.013 (E277, E290)
settings.wall_source: the debug QoS cap of 2 h less 20 min for set-up and the leftover reads; a training whose projected time from its first 30 steps exceeds it stops at once

dry.dry_source: CPU dry run only (run.py --dry OUT): tiny training on x2 with open bars, written under OUT, never under results/

items.targets: x2: E214's built strengthening edit (E195's 8 copy neurons of layer 1, their down_proj columns times 2; P.rescaled), reuse by construction; new_few: P1.31's built new edit (known_edits.build), new by construction. Both from E242's World through experiments/eapig_overlap/items.py Items (E214's edits rebuilt, their record written to this run's results and checked against eapig_overlap/edits_ref.json: the discrete choices must be equal or the job stops)
items.imitators: ft/<target>_s<seed>: M with its 24 decomposed matrices fine-tuned by the recipe to imitate the target on its training windows at its read positions; seeds 0-2 differ in the batch draws only (E139's design); the step-3000 state is read, saved as an fp32 delta per parameter (results/large/dw_<target>_s<seed>.pt)
items.random: ft/<target>_s<seed>_rand: a Gaussian per changed parameter tensor at the imitator's Frobenius norm there (needed_neurons.matched_random), seed random_seed + item index
items.D: each item is read on its target's D at its read positions, as E277 and E268 read the built edits: x2 on E195's 75 copy24 held-out windows at every position, new_few on P1.31's 512 cue windows at the last position
items.neurons: 12 items (2 targets x 3 seeds x imitator and random) at E277's featurization, scan settings E277's filed ones (needed_neurons.load_config)
items.vpd: 4 items (seed 0: 2 targets x imitator and random) at E268's featurization, scan settings E268's filed ones (kstar_needed.load_config), read as E290 read its VPD items (ia3_control.read_vpd)

readings.leftover: TV(fine-tune, F) / TV(fine-tune, M), each a mean over D's windows and read positions of the total variation between next-token distributions (E139's distances, at this item's read positions); also KL(F || fine-tune), KL(M || fine-tune) and the target's own gap TV(F, M)
readings.E_b_K: commute.stand_in.explained_share over K and changed, K by the featurization's single-variable interchange, as E277 filed it (remainders in) at neurons and as E268 at VPD
readings.beside: |K|, n changed in K, median top-1 minus top-2 margin; at neurons E_b over K without the remainders, over the neurons only, and the remainders' share of dd (needed_neurons.remainder_columns); the imitator's |dW|^2

rules.R0a: Stage 0 of each featurization (E277's at neurons, E290's vpd_stage0 at VPD) stops the job on any argmax change under the identity interchange on x2, or unless the do-nothing (F = M) has no changed variable, dd max exactly 0.0 and E_b over K exactly 1.0
rules.R0b: Before training, per target: the untrained copy of M reads TV(copy, M) and KL(M || copy) exactly 0.0 on D, every delta entry exactly 0.0, and the target's gap TV(F, M) is at least floor_gap; a miss stops the job
rules.R0c: Before any imitator is read: x2 and new_few, read again by this run, repeat their prior E_b over K within repeat_tol_neurons at neurons (stage check) and repeat_tol_vpd at VPD (stage vpd); a miss stops every read until it is found
rules.R0d: new_few's rebuilt edit record equals the committed one (eapig_overlap/edits_ref.json) in A, A', y, slots and swapped; a miss stops the job
rules.R1: Early training checks, each a stop: at step 1 (rate 0) KL(M || fine-tune) is exactly 0.0; at steps 2 and 3 it lies in kl_m_band; at overshoot_step KL(F || fine-tune) < KL(F || M) and KL(M || fine-tune) <= KL(M || F) (E139 amendment 2's check); at fall_step KL(F || fine-tune) <= fall_ratio x KL(F || M); the time projected from the first 30 steps is at most wall_s
rules.R2: Closeness bar. An imitator counts only if at step 3000 its target's gap TV(F, M) and its own gap TV(fine-tune, M) are each at least floor_gap and its leftover is at most leftover_max; otherwise it is 'no reading' (with its leftover reported). An item with |K| < too_small reads 'too small to read'
rules.R3: The rivals, at neurons, E_b over K as filed. For each seed where both imitators count and neither item is too small: d = E_b_K(ft/x2) - E_b_K(ft/new_few). Rival A when d >= rival_gap on every such seed, rival B when d < rival_gap on every one, 'split' otherwise. Fewer than min_seeds such seeds: 'no call', with the leftovers reached. The built pair (x2 minus new_few from R0c) is the rule's own positive control, expected A (0.995)
rules.R4: Randoms: each matched random is expected at or under random_max; one above is reported beside its item, not a stop
rules.descriptive: every VPD reading (seed 0, n = 1, no rival call); the leftover at steps 300 and 1000; the columns beside E_b

edge_cases.do_nothing: TV(fine-tune, M) = 0 so the leftover is undefined (division by zero): R2 reads it 'no reading' by the gap floor before any division; at neurons it reads E_b 1 (R0a) and would give d = 0 under R3 (B) if it were an imitator, which R2 keeps out
edge_cases.built_pair: x2 and new_few themselves are not imitators (no training); under R3's difference they read 0.995 >= 0.2: A, the rule's positive control
edge_cases.empty_K: an empty K and changed set reads E_b 1 by convention: |K| < too_small reads 'too small', never a pass
edge_cases.ties: d exactly rival_gap reads A (>=); every d is A or B, so each seed has a call
edge_cases.no_seeds: no seed with both imitators counted: 'no call'; one seed: 'no call' (min_seeds 2), its d reported
edge_cases.x2_no_reach: if every x2 imitator misses the bar the reuse side is 'no reading' and R3 is 'no call' whatever new_few reads

expected.stage0: identity 0 argmax changes, largest logit deviation near E277's 8.2e-5 at neurons and E268's 5.1e-5 at VPD; do-nothing 0 changed, dd max 0.0, E_b 1.0; untrained copy: TV and KL to M 0.0 exactly; repeats: x2 0.999765 and new_few 0.004679 at neurons, 0.761391 and 0.012698 at VPD, within 1e-6 on an L40 like the priors'
expected.gaps: x2's own gap TV(F, M) on D: unmeasured as TV; its KL(F || M) is 0.101 nats (E242 items/x2.json kl_fm), so a TV of about 0.1-0.2, over the 0.02 floor; new_few's KL(F || M) is 10.2 nats (kl_fm), a TV near 1

expected.neurons: lean B: imitators of both targets read like the trained fine-tunes of E277 and E290 (0.014-0.038), d inside the 0.2 gap on every counted seed, the remainders carrying most of dd (0.5-0.8, E277 trained); rival A would put the x2 imitators near the ffn gain arm's 0.24-0.81 (E290) or above, new_few's near 0.005; randoms 0.0004-0.013

expected.time: train: x2 about 0.04 s per step (E147's 1.1 s per 30 steps at 32 windows of 41 tokens), 3000 steps about 2 min; new_few about 1.4 s per step (E139's 0.27 s per step at 1024 windows of 8 tokens, times 41/8 tokens), 3000 steps about 70 min; 3 debug jobs of one new_few and one x2 seed, about 75 min each. check job: stage 0 303 s + x2 1213 s + new_few 308 s (E277 on a cluster L40), about 31 min. neurons: 3 debug jobs of 2 x2-D items (1213 s each) and 2 new_few-D items (308 s each) after a 303 s stage 0, about 56 min each. vpd: stage 0 16 s, x2 1445 s, new_few 515 s (E268 on a cluster L40S), repeats and 4 items 5880 s, about 1.6 h plus set-up on one H100 (fp32 without TF32 is not faster there than an L40S), about $6 at $3/h
